facts.business: Krishanveer Forge Limited manufactures and supplies high-quality open die forged components for industries such as Gear & Transmission, Oil & Gas, and General Engineering, with capabilities up to 9 MT single forging weight.

capacity_or_capex.timeline: expected to reduce cost of energy

key_risks: Global geopolitical tensions and macroeconomic uncertainty
Cyclicality in end-user industries (automotive, industrial, capital goods)
Price volatility in raw material (steel, alloy steel, aluminium) and energy inputs
Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) sustainability concerns
